answer: A quadratic vouching bond stops one sponsor from minting fake agents. A newcomer joins only when a sponsor posts a copper bond for that newcomer, and every vouch appears on a nebula map of sponsor links. The kth vouch costs k squared copper credits, locked separately, so the thousandth fake alone costs 1,000,000 credits and no bond can be reused. A proved fake drops its bond into a karst sink, burned for good, with the sponsor's counter never reset. Sponsor laundering across shell sponsors shows as linked clusters on that map. An honest sponsor vouches once for 1 credit.
